draft.change: Add the gentilic צְמָרִי with its collective use in the genealogy of Canaan.
draft.definition: A Zemarite, a member of one of the Canaanite clans.
draft.evidence: Genesis 10:18 names the Zemarites among the Canaanite families and uses a singular gentilic for the group.

analysis.evidence: Genesis 10:18 lists הַצְּמָרִי between the Arvadite and the Hamathite, introducing each with וְאֶת. The closing phrase מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַכְּנַעֲנִי, “the families of the Canaanite,” identifies the groups just listed.
analysis.morphology: The definite article הַ doubles the initial צ of the masculine singular absolute gentilic noun צְמָרִי. The singular designates the clan collectively.
analysis.sense: A member of the Zemarite clan, here denoting the clan as a whole.
